name: A database-loaded Moonstalker Matriarch has exactly two runts, not four (#4348)
contract: A creature loaded from the creature table runs SMART_EVENT_RESPAWN twice before anyone touches it: once from SmartAI::InitializeAI while it enters the world and again from Creature::Update, which calls JustRespawned for every non-summon on its first update. A matriarch summoned by a player skips the second pass, so the fixture-based #4348 scenario cannot see it.

Darkshore Matriarch spawn 36967 (map 1, 7818.77, -982.033, 32.4169, phase 1) is the real spawn the other #4348 scenario copies. No wild Moonstalker Runt spawn is within 800 yards of it, so every runt near the observer belongs to this matriarch.

The observer enters the phase the spawn lives in and counts the level 16-17 runts the matriarch summoned. The reported behavior is two runts; four means each respawn pass summoned a pair. The count must stay at two after the creature has had time to run its first updates.

steps.label: The observer joins the phase the database spawns live in
The database matriarch is within sight
Exactly two runts stand around the database matriarch
Let the matriarch run further updates
No late pair of runts appears
Both runts have the reported level
